title: Negation preserves influence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\\{−1,1\\}$, and let $i$ be one of its coordinates. The probability that flipping coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$ is unchanged when every output of $f$ is negated.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
